company.name: CustomerOS
company.shortDescription: CustomerOS helps B2B marketing teams transform anonymous website visitors into a qualified sales pipeline.
company.description:
CustomerOS helps B2B companies transform anonymous website visitors into a qualified sales pipeline. Our platform identifies in-market accounts, matches them to your ideal customer profile (ICP), and detects their buying stage in real time. We deliver actionable insights that enable marketing and sales teams to prioritize the right prospects and increase conversion rates. Beyond visitor identification, CustomerOS also optimizes your content strategy, improving SEO performance, organic discoverability, and engagement timing through AI-driven recommendations. Designed for growth-focused B2B organizations, CustomerOS helps you generate more pipeline, accelerate revenue, and maximize ROI.
We have recently been rated Europe’s #1 early-stage, B2B SaaS/Cloud company.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 82 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
